Prima & Timo — (4) Timo (Ver. 4.0) Nonaginta Novem

Biomimicry

"Knowing some of these voices' he could easily place"

Biomimicry

[Office hum + paper shuffling]

[Verse 1]

Principium sat at his desk, surrounded by endless stacks

Papers to approve, memos to send, meetings to track

The weight of the Mainframe rested on his paranoid mind

Every little detail — he had to keep it perfectly aligned

But then he saw it — the dreaded suggestion box

Anonymous comments, the bane of his existence, the paradox

He opened it slowly, heart already starting to race

Knowing some of these voices… he could easily place

[Pre-Chorus]

“Make Blue Bananas permanent” — Exemplar, without a doubt

“Declare every Monday a holiday” — Excolo acting out

[Chorus — tense & humorous]

Biomimicry

The system must stay pure

Biomimicry

No room for the absurd

I design perfection, I design the grand design

Why must they keep pushing chaos into mine?

[Verse 2]

“I think your work lately needs improvement” — Sustentare’s tone

He crumpled the paper, paranoia fully grown

Another from Ingen, another from the crew

Criticism disguised as “helpful” — he knew it through and through

He stared at the box like it was a living threat

Every folded note another reason to fret

The Architect of everything, the one who must not fail

Yet here he was… rattled by a wooden mail

[Pre-Chorus 2]

He picked up the phone, voice tight with control

Dialed the one person who might make him feel whole

[Chorus — tense & humorous]

Biomimicry

The system must stay pure

Biomimicry

No room for the absurd

I design perfection, I design the grand design

Why must they keep pushing chaos into mine?

[Bridge — colder]

Data answered on the other side, voice calm and clear

“How are we progressing?” Principium asked with fear

Data paused, then replied with measured tone

“Veera sent the wrong package… we’re no longer alone.”

[Fun acoustic melodic solo]

[CODA]

As the Architect I was careful with the payload

Made sure to check every language, every code

But this Veera is becoming an additional stress

Adding more chaos to this whole mess

[Pre-Chorus 2]

He then called the team we need to meet tonight

Everybody declined everybody had plans tonight

[Chorus — tense & humorous]

Biomimicry

The system still must endure

Biomimicry

Relax and just breathe

I design perfection, I design the grand design

Why must they keep pushing chaos into mine?

[Outro — ominous]

Principium stared into nothing, the suggestion box still open wide

“…This cycle is broken,” he whispered, full of pride.

[Outro — fading hum]
